Prespecify a random time-stratified video annotation frame sample

Source: R/video-annotation-sampling.R
aqt_annotation_frame_plan.Rd

Samples only from independently acquired video PTS manifests, not YOLO predictions, detections, tracker confidence or inferred fish presence. Frames are split into equal-duration time strata WITHIN each camera recording, and a balanced number of acquired frames is sampled per stratum using an RNG state that is restored before returning. Required strata without frames or enough acquired frames fail closed, rather than silently reducing or shifting the annotation sample.

Usage

aqt_annotation_frame_plan(frames, per_video = 60L, strata = 6L, seed = 11L)

Arguments

frames

Verified aqt_frame_manifest including zero-fish frames.

per_video

Number of acquired frames to sample independently for every camera-local recording; positive integer.

strata

Number of equal-duration temporal strata per recording, <= per_video and >=2. Each must supply its allocated frames.

seed

Explicit nonnegative integer RNG seed.

Value

aqt_annotation_plan frame table with sample probabilities, inverse selection weights and an unannotated status marker.

Details

A plan is NOT a list of already annotated frames. Its annotation_status is "planned_not_annotated" until real manual annotation is completed; the bundle scorer explicitly rejects it. After actual independent full-frame annotation, the caller may set annotation_status to "fully_annotated" for those reviewed frames.
